=== rung 1
Ask what one pass over the readings can remember as you go.
=== rung 2
Keep a record of each reading, and look it up when you need a partner.
=== rung 3
Work out what the pair must total, then check the case where the answer is 41.
=== rung 4
Use a dictionary to store what you have seen, then check each new reading against it.
